newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 24.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Newspaper says has copy of a strategic defence agreement signed at the Nuremburg bilateral summit in December by German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and President Jacques Chirac.

-- The government, having reached an agreement with Dassault Aviation on price cuts for Rafale combat plane, is set to place a multi-year order for 48 planes, a "first" for France where annual procurement has been the rule.
-- Lyonnaise des Eaux gains bridgehead in the Asia market with a water contract for the Philippine capital.
-- Employees of distressed lender Credit Foncier de France believe they are winning struggle to prevent break-up and closure of the institution.
-- Lagardere executive Noel Forgeard no longer opposes a privatisation of Thomson-CSF through a share flotation as long as it is accompanied by a group of stable shareholders.
